model.name: fileDetail.showFileNotCollection
model.description: BUG18: file click in room tree must open file's OWN detail, not parent collection. Root cause: tagMap has no 'file' entry → falls back to rb-detail-view (generic) → shows parent. Fix: (1) create rb-file-detail.ts component, (2) add 'file':'rb-file-detail' to tagMap in renderDetailForRef. File detail renders: header (File+name+mimeType+size), ContentPreviewer inline, browse-file link (/md/ with highlight), scenario editor link (/edit/ Monaco).
